task.title: Implement GitHub approval bus for mobile approvals
task.summary_zh: 建立 GitHub approval bus，讓 review 自動同步到 PR、blocked 自動同步到 issue，並把手機上的 approve/comment 透過 orchestrator polling 回寫到共享狀態。
task.next: GitHub approval bus is implemented locally: PR/issue sync, mobile comment commands, webhook intake, cloud relay interfaces, and templates are in place.
